evidenceClasses.bounded-cost-evaluation: Deterministic result over the four enumerated routes and named cost profile.
evidenceClasses.declared-counterfactual: Onto2D route-space declaration with no claim of chemical feasibility.
evidenceClasses.exact-source-string-equality: Derived equality over byte-exact native identifier strings; not physical-batch continuity.
evidenceClasses.ord-dataset-membership: Reaction membership in the pinned ORD Dataset protobuf.
evidenceClasses.ord-reaction-field: Identifier, condition, or role retained from a selected native ORD reaction field.
evidenceClasses.ord-reaction-id-cross-reference: Native ORD reaction_id reference from a later input to an earlier reaction record.
evidenceClasses.ord-reaction-outcome: Desired product or measurement retained from a selected native ORD outcome.

identityRegimes.same-route-fragment: Do reactants, catalyst, base, additive, conditions, workup, and record identity all match?
identityRegimes.same-target-identifier: Do these records carry the exact same source product SMILES?

boundary.note: Exact SMILES string equality is not canonical molecular identity or physical-batch continuity; +2 is limited to the declared islatravir route space.
boundary.summary: Native ORD identifiers and reaction_id continuity remain separate from derived equivalence, counterfactual routes, and Historical Load.
